title: The outcome of every test of one run (<run folder>/results.json)
description: Written by `gatekit test` at the end of a run and printed by `test --json`. docs/contracts/cli.md, "test".

sort.description: blocking: a state that waits for the player, neither asked for nor allowed; participant: a creature that is not of the cast; unplaced: a row no registry places.

what.description: The kind of the rows, or the creature's uuid.

waits.description: Seconds inside each kind of wait of `game`: wait, wait_row, wait_attention, answer, wait_state, sleep.

exit.description: The exit code: 0 all passed, 1 a failure or a test not run, 2 none failed and a precondition unmet.

slowest.description: The slowest steps of the run, slowest first.

waits.description: Seconds of it inside waits of `game`.

answers.description: Seconds of it in the game's own answers to its chunks, outside any wait.
Seconds of the run in the game's own answers to the tests' chunks, outside any wait.

test.description: The test's id: its path under the folder given, without .lua.

steps.description: Its steps; empty for a test with cases, whose steps are under its cases.

cases.description: Its cases, in order: variations of its rule, each run from a clean scene. Empty for a test without.

name.description: The case's name: its address is <test>/<name>.

reset.description: What the reset ladder did before it.

surprises.description: What the event log holds that the test did not ask for. A report, not part of the outcome.
